anchors: Eqs76/78/79: hadron2 frame and P_hperp/z1 Fourier variable
Eqs82/85/86/91/92: separate integrated polarized and unpolarized yields
primary_source.scope: Equation and cut provenance only; no recovered author program, joint acceptance or experimental admission

definition.coordinate: qT=P_hperp/z1 at fixed theory z1; use the z1 already present in the prepared context
definition.bounds: Require explicit finite 0<=lower_qT<upper_qT, a nonblank source and nonblank lower-limit provenance; neither endpoint is inferred from the experiment name or a reported mean
definition.jacobian: P*dP=z1^2*qT*dqT; absolute U/L polarized and unpolarized integrals must all retain this Jacobian before normalization
definition.ratio: Integrate the four signed charge-pair yields, sum U/L and C=U+L, then form the parent's linearized UL/UC amplitude
definition.angular: Preserve the supplied SIAAngularFactor or SIAMeanOfRatio kind, value, source and measure unchanged; no conversion between angular averages
definition.fixed_parameters: Window limits, z1 and quadrature are fixed preparation settings; differentiation of cuts or kinematic variables is unsupported
definition.lower_zero_scope: Zero is a caller-declared radial origin in the synthetic test, not a newly certified experimental lower cut

validation_policy.refinement_policy: Retain all coarse levels; at or above order32 accept only an adjacent-order difference within the fixed parent limit. Exhaustion is FAIL; do not widen a limit after observing a result.
validation_policy.absolute_yield_policy: Compare projected radial weights and separate unnormalized U/L yields, not only asymmetries: omitting a common Jacobian at fixed z can cancel from the ratio and must still fail.

synthetic_fixture.row_scope: Explicitly synthetic fixed response rows, polynomial initial inputs and uniform momentum acceptance; no native evolution accuracy or physical data
required_checks: Exact P-bound mapping and retained cut/angular provenance
Absolute P*dP polynomial/Gaussian moments against closed 256-bit integrals
Projected P weights, separate charge-category yields and ratios versus independent adaptive qT integration
Adjacent momentum refinements with all levels retained
All thirteen gradient columns and HVP against independent scalar qT reference and two-step 256-bit finite differences; SIA transversity columns must remain zero
Equal angular scalars preserve both typed paths without relabelling their source definitions
Invalid/nonfinite/differentiated bounds, missing provenance, wrong process and stale quadrature/metadata reject
Counterfactual missing common Jacobian is detected through absolute integrals even where the ratio is unchanged
Counterfactual average of pointwise asymmetries does not replace ratio of integrated yields

limitations: No experimental rows, values, errors, selection, covariance or overlap are changed; historical262 and current candidate825 intake remain as before
Not a full z-bin/event acceptance integration, finite-mass energy/momentum-fraction conversion or identification of mean(P/z) with mean(P)/mean(z)
The qT<3.5 upper-cut source does not certify the rest of a publication's acceptance or lower limit; unresolved Belle corrected primary bytes remain unresolved
No Y term, thrust-frame A12, altered signs/mass/z factors, evolution or likelihood; parent physical-accuracy/missing-code limitations stay explicit
No historical chi2 reproduction, real-data executor/admission, optimizer/replica coverage, full-x lattice or production performance certificate
Generic fixed-row scalar references share prepared evolution rows and initial functions; they independently test integration/assembly, not an independent evolution solution
